methodology.inventory: Pinned git ls-tree -r --name-only <revision> -- <root>, git ls-files membership, git grep/rg-style discovery, git show <revision>:<path> reads. All tracked paths=855; source/fixture bodies=827. No working-tree content used as revision evidence.
methodology.options: Correlated enum opportunities include operation receipts, sync pending rounds, exec/host operations, rules, reset attempts, title receipts, voice sessions. Preserve intentional Stored/Field Missing vs Null, radio Option<Option>, review absent title, optional monitor dimensions and unknown price/token fields; no mechanical conversion of all Options.
methodology.paths: Inventory paths relative to scope; sorted ASCII/byte order. For hashes prefix scope, join LF with a final LF, hash UTF-8 with SHA-256. Scanned manifest is sorted union production+testSource; complete list reconstructible directly from attached groups.
methodology.preservation: Authorization, canonical request/signature identity, epoch/generation/account/thread, numerical/byte/time bounds, paths/hashes, stale snapshots, and unknown-outcome no-resend remain runtime checks. A typed decoder replaces shape checks only with equivalent acceptance behavior. Cross-language schemas require one owner plus generated consumers or parity.
methodology.priorities: P1 concrete bounded opportunity with clear owner; P2 migration requires compatibility work; P3 deferred deeper trace; none means keep existing approach. These are migration priorities, not bug severity.
methodology.references: Family evidence paths relative to scope/src/ unless explicitly outside-root; short submodule references share named family directory. Support reads outside scope were only required producer/shared owner sources (runtime schema/store/provider/process, VM guest service/native/mac_sync/host-exec protocol and native desktop filesystem event Swift source), not additional root censuses.
methodology.scan: Every production path has a metric row, including zero matches. Regex hit counts are discovery only; may miss aliases/macros/indexing-only accesses. No build, tests, installs, source edits, OS input, live state/model/credit reads or changes. Relevant repository/engineering-protocol guidance and source READMEs read. Known unrelated build defect not investigated.

overview: Read-only systematic census at the named commit. Every tracked file is inventoried, all included source/fixture bodies read for inventory, and every production module assigned to a subsystem. Detailed regex candidate metrics apply to production-containing files. 82 logical family dispositions: 40 remove fixed Value/projection plumbing, 17 already typed, 11 retain raw/opaque boundary, 14 unresolved. 70 rows use focused source-body producer→decode→decision traces; 12 structural/declaration-call traces explicitly state limits. This is NOT a claim that every module/line/branch was manually read. No arbitrary top-N filter was applied. Findings are refactoring candidates, not demonstrated runtime defects; every witness is proposed, not executed.
title: Read-only systematic runtime-services type census
